          "to_next": "Armed with proof of the skim, Rhea decides to weaponize the system's own audit rules."
        },
        "chapter_id": 4,
        "chapter_role": "investigation",
        "goal": "Investigate the local quest payouts and discover that the Ledger's standard rewards are being actively siphoned by a local administrator.",
        "pacing": {
          "expected_scene_count": 8,
          "intensity": 3,
          "tempo": "slow_burn"
        },
        "sections": [
          {
            "end_condition": "Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.",
            "intent": "As the party grinds quests, Rhea notices the math on XP and loot yields doesn't match the System's stated formulas.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:2",
                "location_end": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_ASH_THICKETS_1BA26D",
                "location_end_label": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_start": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "Rhea identifies a consistent 14.3% deficit in their quest rewards compared to the raw System formulas.",
                "scene_id": 1,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 25,
                "summary": "The newly formed party takes on a standard gathering quest in the Ash Thickets to test their contract. After completing it, Rhea notices the XP and loot drops are exactly 14.3% lower than the System's stated base rates in the contract syntax.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "glowing green contract window",
                  "physical quest board",
                  "kiosk chassis",
                  "gray dirt"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Rhea closes the glowing green contract window, turning her attention to the physical quest board bolted to the kiosk chassis.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "gray dirt",
                  "severed ash-boar tusk",
                  "projected loot table",
                  "kneeling woman"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She kneels in the gray dirt, comparing the severed ash-boar tusk to the projected loot table hovering above her palm.",
                "type": "progression"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:1",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:3",
                "location_end": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_ASH_THICKETS_1BA26D",
                "location_end_label": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_start": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_ASH_THICKETS_1BA26D",
                "location_start_label": "Ash Thickets",
                "outcome": "Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "seam_resolution": "micro_scene",
                "seam_score": 65,
                "summary": "Rhea forces Unit 734 to pull up the historical logs for the last fifty local quests. She cross-references the data, compiling a makeshift ledger on a piece of scrap parchment that proves the local node is mathematically skimming off the top.",
                "threads": [
                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "boar blood",
                  "iron bludgeon",
                  "charred tree trunk",
                  "projected historical logs"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vance wipes boar blood from his iron bludgeon while Rhea demands the drone project the historical quest logs against a charred tree trunk.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "scrap parchment",
                  "charcoal stick",
                  "undeniable deficit",
                  "rolled document"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She rolls up the scrap parchment, tapping the charcoal stick against her chin as she stares at the undeniable deficit.",
                "type": "investigation"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:2",
                "end_condition_echo": "Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:4",
                "location_end": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start": "Ash Thickets",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_ASH_THICKETS_1BA26D",
                "location_start_label": "Ash Thickets",
                "outcome": "The party travels back to the Outpost Kiosk, solidifying their proof of the mathematical discrepancy.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 20,
                "summary": "Hiking back from the Ash Thickets, Rhea explains the math of the deficit to Vance. Unit 734 nervously processes the implications of an impending audit as they arrive at the Outpost Kiosk, ready to confront the system's routing logic.",
                "threads": [
                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "rolled document",
                  "ashy trail",
                  "muttering drone",
                  "heavy footsteps"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Clutching the rolled document, Rhea leads the way down the ashy trail, ignoring the muttering drone and Vance's heavy footsteps behind her.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "kiosk silhouette",
                  "rusted chassis",
                  "determined grip",
                  "flickering screen"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The kiosk's silhouette looms ahead, and Rhea tightens her grip on the parchment as she approaches the rusted chassis and its flickering screen.",
                "type": "exploration"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "Mathematical Discrepancies"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.",
            "intent": "The party investigates the missing value, tracking it through the local frontier node's routing system.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:3",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:5",
                "location_end": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "Rhea bypasses the drone's basic security filters to reveal a hidden routing sub-routine siphoning the rewards.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 20,
                "summary": "Back at the Outpost, Rhea interrogates Unit 734 about where the missing 14.3% goes. The drone insists it goes to 'Node Maintenance,' but Rhea uses her fraud investigator skills to trace the routing logic, finding a hidden sub-routine.",
                "threads": [
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "rusted kiosk port",
                  "flickering optical lens",
                  "diagnostic queries",
                  "docked drone"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The drone docks with the rusted kiosk port, its optical lens flickering as Rhea inputs a series of diagnostic queries.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "stuttering green text",
                  "secondary data stream",
                  "administrative spire",
                  "kiosk screen"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The green text stutters, revealing a secondary data stream flowing toward the administrative spire in the distance.",
                "type": "puzzle"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:4",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:6",
                "location_end": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_end_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "The party infiltrates the restricted Maintenance Trenches, defeating a low-level security construct to follow the data conduit.",
                "scene_id": 5,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 25,
                "summary": "The party follows the physical manifestation of the data stream\u2014a series of buried, glowing conduit lines\u2014into the restricted Maintenance Trenches beneath the outpost. Vance handles a minor security construct that tries to block their path.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "heavy iron grate",
                  "base of the kiosk",
                  "narrow glowing tunnel",
                  "ashy surface"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Vance pries open the heavy iron grate at the base of the kiosk, revealing a narrow, glowing tunnel beneath the ash.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "shattered brass construct",
                  "sparking wires",
                  "stone floor",
                  "blue conduit"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The shattered remains of the brass security construct spark on the stone floor as Rhea steps over it to follow the blue conduit.",
                "type": "exploration"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:5",
                "end_condition_echo": "The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:7",
                "location_end": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_end_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_start_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "outcome": "The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.",
                "scene_id": 6,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 15,
                "summary": "Deep in the trenches, they find a physical server terminal\u2014the digital skim point. Rhea analyzes the terminal and discovers the stolen rewards are being routed directly to the local administrator's personal offshore Ledger account.",
                "threads": [
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "damp humming chamber",
                  "massive brass server terminal",
                  "leaking blue light",
                  "narrow tunnel exit"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The narrow tunnel opens into a damp, humming chamber dominated by a massive brass server terminal leaking blue light.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "thick glowing cable",
                  "brass terminal",
                  "etched account tag",
                  "narrowed eyes"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Rhea traces the thickest glowing cable from the terminal, her eyes narrowing at the administrator's personal account tag etched into the brass.",
                "type": "investigation"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "Tracking the Leak"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.",
            "intent": "Rhea secures hard evidence of the administrative fraud before the system can wipe the logs.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:6",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "4:8",
                "location_end": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_end_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_start_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "outcome": "Rhea successfully extracts the raw data packet containing the skim logs before the terminal can wipe its memory.",
                "scene_id": 7,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 15,
                "summary": "The terminal's automated defense system detects their intrusion and begins a localized memory wipe to destroy the logs. Rhea frantically works to extract the raw data packet while Vance physically holds the terminal's cooling vents open to prevent a hard reset.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "shrill alarm",
                  "damp chamber",
                  "flashing red terminal",
                  "memory wipe protocol"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "A shrill alarm pierces the damp chamber as the brass terminal flashes red, initiating a localized memory wipe protocol.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "scorching cooling vents",
                  "stone floor",
                  "glowing data crystal",
                  "cursing man"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vance releases the scorching cooling vents with a curse, dropping to the stone floor as Rhea clutches the glowing data crystal.",
                "type": "puzzle"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "4:7",
                "end_condition_echo": "Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.",
                "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
                "location_end": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_end_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_MAINTENANCE_TRENCHES_A2BF25",
                "location_start_label": "Maintenance Trenches",
                "outcome": "Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.",
                "scene_id": 8,
                "summary": "With the data crystal in hand, Rhea realizes the local system will try to delete it from her standard inventory. She exploits a loophole in their new custom party contract to bind the crystal as a 'Soul-Bound Liability,' locking it into her unalterable personal System inventory.",
                "threads": [
                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "rhea_survival"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "dull amber lights",
                  "pulsing data crystal",
                  "decaying durability meter",
                  "open palm"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The red alarm lights fade to a dull amber as Rhea stares at the pulsing data crystal in her palm, watching its durability meter rapidly decay.",
                "type": "progression"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "Securing the Evidence"
          }
        ],
        "stakes_shift": "From surviving the environment to recognizing the environment is a managed fraud scheme.",
        "title": "The Skim"
      }
    ]
  },
  "phase_report": {
    "window_id": "ch04_win01",
    "touched_scene_refs": [
      "4:2",
      "4:3",
      "4:4"
    ],
    "touched_fields": [
      "handoff_mode",
      "hands_off_to",
      "consumes_outcome_from",
      "end_condition_echo"
    ],
    "updated_character_ids": [],
    "notes": [
      "Verified sequential links between 4:2, 4:3, and 4:4.",
      "Updated 4:2 handoff_mode to direct_continuation to match the narrative flow into 4:3.",
      "Confirmed end_condition_echo on 4:3 matches Section 1 end condition."
    ]
  }
}
